description:
Your simple video editor for creating wow videos

Your simple video editor for creating wow videos
- Easily create clips for your socials, business, or family
- Boost your videos with one-click auto subtitles and other AI tools
- Choose from hundreds of titles, transitions, and music tracks
- Adjust Blocks’ length to fit your footage perfectly. Before, every Block had a set duration, so longer clips got cut short. Now you can drag its edges just like a regular clip and make it as long or short as you need – so your best moments stay in.
- Enjoy a clearer, more convenient way to crop. The Crop tool now shows a before-and-after preview and an Applied status right after you hit the button, with a quick undo option nearby. Plus, cropped clips are now marked on the timeline for easier navigation.
- Find the right element faster with smarter search. Type what you have in mind – like a color or a mood – and get relevant results, even when the exact word isn’t in the title. The perfect match is just a search away!
